response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS baseline_avg FROM status_averages), kept AS (SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex, b.baseline_avg FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE sa.avg_modindex > b.baseline_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - baseline_avg AS above_baseline, avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: “Differs from” means a signed difference: the status average minus the mean of kept status averages.

alternatives.interpretation: “How far it differs” means an absolute distance.
alternatives.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS baseline_avg FROM status_averages), kept AS (SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex, b.baseline_avg FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE sa.avg_modindex > b.baseline_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - baseline_avg AS above_baseline, ABS(avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER ()) AS distance_from_kept_mean FROM kept;
